attendance_crmt: A locally verifiable Attendance CRMT REST v1 implementation and its versioned contract for adapter parity testing
configuration: Approved non-secret configuration for the Attendance CRMT REST base URL and adapter runtime

open_issues_or_blockers: Local adapter tests verify the fourteen-tool canonical requester, catalog, administrative, and reporting MCP inventory; route/argument mappings; MCP schemas; contract-version headers; allowed header propagation; CRMT safe-error filtering; session admission; and public liveness.
The repository-owned migration contract identifies Attendance MCP as the public Streamable HTTP owner and CRMT REST as its private authority while preserving MCP contract 1.2.0.
The local Docker image attendance-mcp:local-test builds successfully from the merged adapter source.

Structured runtime logging is locally verified with development console DEBUG output, non-local JSON INFO output, UTC and callsite metadata, request-scoped trace context, and recursive redaction of configured sensitive keys and values.

Project-owned logging is locally verified: adapter structured events remain development DEBUG or non-local INFO, standard-library external logs default to WARNING, FastMCP follows that policy, Uvicorn retains one INFO access record, and ATTENDANCE_MCP_LOG_EXTERNAL_DEBUG explicitly enables external DEBUG diagnostics.

Public health and MCP HTTP lifecycle instrumentation is locally verified: received and completed/failed events include a valid or logging-only UUID trace ID, route, status, duration, safe local header-admission outcome, and safe CRMT admission outcome.

All fourteen read-only MCP tools use a shared internal tool-call policy and their sole CRMT REST-client seam remains unchanged. The policy derives stable value-free handler labels and sanitized input shapes from each typed handler interface, centralizes header forwarding and safe-error translation, and preserves lifecycle timing and outcomes. In-process Streamable HTTP regressions verify admitted requester and reporting tool calls emit safe MCP and CRMT lifecycles and preserve route arguments and allowed headers.

All fifteen named CRMT REST-client operations, including session admission, locally derive their concrete request path and value-free lifecycle identity from one private immutable operation record. In-process REST-client tests verify each public operation's method, route, stable operation label, and safe route template; the prior reverse route parser is removed.

The contract-1.2.0 Streamable HTTP catalog is locally verified with fourteen string-described, read-only annotated legacy tools and the compatible requester schema. The in-process Teams bot MCP session discovers and admits that catalog using fixture-only transport. Verified with 39 local tests, Ruff lint, and formatting checks.
No authorized non-production deployment, Entra/OBO, CRMT audit-record comparison, or end-to-end embedded-bridge parity evidence exists; local implementation does not clear these external gates.
